# GTA Washer & Dryer Rentals

> Washer and dryer rental in Toronto and the GTA, Ontario, Canada. $12.50 a week for a washer + dryer set, $6.25 a week for one machine. Repairs and old-machine haul-away included. Run by Vlad in Toronto.

## Contact

- Phone (call or text): (437) 907-6955
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 7 pm. Sunday closed.
- Website: https://washerrent.com/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61588384887072
- Languages: English, Spanish and Russian

## Offer

- Washer + dryer set: $12.50 a week (CAD)
- One machine (washer only or dryer only): $6.25 a week (CAD)
- Repairs included: repair or a replacement machine at no charge
- Old machine haul-away included, at no charge
- Delivery and installation: quoted per job, before you pay
- Machine types: stackable pair, one-piece laundry centre (24" or 27" wide), side-by-side front-load, side-by-side top-load, single washer or dryer
- Machines are pre-owned, checked before they go out, in good working order. Brand and model depend on availability.

## Terms

- $200 refundable deposit, returned when the machine comes back working
- 52-week minimum, then week to week with 30 days' notice
- No credit check
- Delivery usually the same week
- Payment by e-Transfer or card
- Referral: $100 when a referred friend signs up for 12 months or more

## What the space needs

- Hot and cold water hookups and a drain
- Most electric dryers need a 240V outlet, 3- or 4-prong
- A vented dryer needs a vent to the outside

## Service area

Toronto (North York, Etobicoke, Scarborough, East York, York), Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill. Farther away: ask.

## About

Run by Vlad in Toronto, who has more than 3 years of experience installing and fixing washers and dryers. He checks each machine before it goes out, connects the water, drain, power and vent, and runs a test cycle before leaving.
